title: How LinkedIn Saved My Life | My $1,000,000 Story
description:
Join my Live Training - September 23 (How to Get 3-5 Clients/Month From LinkedIn):  https://onlinesalesmasterytraining.com/yt-content-linkedin-training

 Follow me on LinkedIn here: 
https://www.linkedin.com/in/saarim-asady/
transcript: by 2018 I got evicted from my office because I could not pay the rent I had two failed businesses and I had credit card companies calling me because I had so much debt and they were ringing me to see when I could get them their money as quickly as possible but despite all of that by 2023 I made almost a million dollars just from LinkedIn and in this video I'm going to explain to you my entire journey of how I was able to go from this terrible situation all the way to Growing the most successful LinkedIn coaching company in the world so without any further Ado let's dive in so this story dated all the way back to 2017 now at the time I just finished my undergraduate degree and I knew I wanted to be an entrepreneur it was one of the most important things in my life but I didn't even know where I wanted to go with entrepreneurship I didn't know if I wanted to go into real estate Tech Finance like I it was such a completely unknown for me all I knew is that I wanted to be an entrepreneur so one day I found this master's program that my University was offering and it was a master's in entrepreneurship and they pretty much promised that you're going to go in learn how to start a business make a lot of money achieve all the financial Freedom you could possibly imagine so I said great sign me up now this program was not cheap it was $30,000 to enroll into this program plus living cost at the University it was a lot of student loan money just to take on to run this and get into this but I did it anyways now within the first two weeks of starting this program I immediately knew this program was not going to get me to where I wanted to go it was just a lot of broad information it wasn't bad it was just not what I needed it was just a lot of broad random information about entrepreneurship stuffed into a program and I realized at that point I needed to figure this out on my own so what I did was I started to reach out to other entrepreneurs I knew who are around my age I started to reach out to friends colleagues all of these people and the first person I reached out to was actually my best friend at the time who was running a marketing agency and I asked him I said hey man can you show me what you're doing with your entire business I just want to learn this entire world and he said said sure no problem so we literally met every single week every Monday evening we would have a one-on-one call together and he would show me everything he was doing in his business now these calls were literally the most valuable business calls I've ever had in my entire life he showed me the ropes of Entrepreneurship then after a few months of learning from him he reached out to me and he said look I think it's time you start your own thing you know you've been learning it's time to put this into action so I said okay what do you recommend I do I really looked up to him I really looked up to him as a mentor at the time he said look from everything I've learned about digital marketing I'm telling you starting a blog would be the best business for you I said why he said look it's a very simple business model you create a blog you get viewers to this blog and Google will pay you money by paying you through their AdSense you know those banner ads you see on websites Google literally pays you and at the time they were paying about $2 for every thousand views you were getting on your website which to me didn't sound bad at all I was like okay well I can get a th000 views and he said all right well let's do it so I literally Dove head first into this and within 6 months of launching this business I am ended up growing the blog to a million readers now I thought I was on top of the world I was like yes got a million readers now at this time I had already graduated the program so this was my full-time operation school was done now I was all in on this business and when I got to a million readers I didn't realize that a million readers paying you $2 per thousand viewers is actually only $500 a month so I was literally only making $500 a month doing this living in k this was not enough to live alone this was not enough to even take care of myself so it put me in a really really tough situation I was happy I built a business but it wasn't to the level that I needed it to be and to get it to 10 20 30 million views would be extremely hard so I knew I had to figure something else out so this is when I decided okay let me put this business on the side let's just keep this rolling on autopilot and let's figure something else out so by this point it's already 2018 I'm fully out of school and I'm thinking what should I do so I decided to start a marketing agency I knew enough about digital marketing to go out and get buyers for other business owners and at the time I found LinkedIn and I was scrolling through Linkedin one day and I was like look at this this is literally a platform where business owners are on where all professionals around the world are spending their time yet nobody's producing content on this platform and it's very easy to engage with people so I said okay you know what this is the platform that I'm going to work on then I decided on my Niche the people that I was going to Target to work with to be Financial planners so I had two things at my disposal now I had my niche of financial planners and I had LinkedIn as the platform so I said okay I'm going to go out and get clients for financial planners using LinkedIn so then me being the smart guy I thought I was I decided you know what I need to do to make this business work I need to go and rent an office in downtown Toronto a very expensive office that's luxurious I'm going to set up a big studio in there record content for my clients publish to do it all now looking back that's probably of the dumbest things I could ever do but I ended up doing that I put all the money I had every penny even like credit card money I threw it all in to building this studio in this office that I could not afford and I launched the business probably one of the biggest risks I'd ever taken in my life at that time now surprisingly I actually got off to a pretty decent start with this business I started bringing in clients they were coming into my studio I was filming content for them then managing their LinkedIn profiles going out bringing them clients and it worked I started charging every about $1,200 a month and then boom it just started stacking and stacking and stacking but then I hit a major road block all of a sudden the client started dropping off they were saying oh what you know what we're good we got all the clients we need we're rolling thank you so much for your help and boom they were not coming back and all of a sudden I started to get into this tough situation where I had to pay this expensive rent every single month and I was not making any money now things were getting bad for me because when there's more more money going out then there's more money coming in you can't do things you are now restricted and I tried to fight through this month after month after month go now I'll never forget this day it was a cold February morning and I get the call from my friend saying get out of the office before the landlord comes or else we're all going to be screwed so I had to pack all my studio equipment get it packed in a matter of 30 minutes and just Evacuate the office now the worst part about this was I had no money money in my pocket or my bank account I remember looking at my bank account now Not only was it at zero it was below zero my overdraft limit was $1500 and I was already at $487 meaning I only have $13 left to spend that wasn't even my money in the first place and I remember calling the Uber just praying that I would have enough to afford this to be able to put all my stuff in the back of this Uber and then head back home and live with my brother who I was staying with at the time because again I couldn't afford rent or anything like that I remember calling the Uber and it was $111 so I was like oh my God thank God so I ended up putting all my stuff in the back of this Uber driving to my brother's house and then boom packed all my stuff in the closet and I just remember lying on my bed thinking like this is this is nuts like how am I going to make this work like why am I failing why is entrepreneurship so hard like what has happened in my life to get me to this point and I remember calling my dad and I to be honest I was crying I was crying on the phone with my dad saying dad I don't think I can be an entrepreneur like this is too hard like why everything I've tried the blog didn't work this marketing agency didn't work like what am I going to do with my life and he told me he said look this is all part of the plan this is all part of making you the entrepreneur you want to become and I didn't understand what he was saying but now it makes a lot of sense so I literally wiped my tears and said okay all right we got to get back to the drawing board so I literally that night while I was in bed created an entire game plan to restart the marketing agency okay this time around I'm not going to spend all this money on an office I don't need I'm not going to do anything I don't need I'm just going to operate a very lean model and it can be completely remote so that's exactly what I did and it worked within 3 months I literally rebuilt this entire business into an online marketing agency where I was still bringing in clients from all over the US and Canada now and I was doing it from literally my bedroom in my brother's apartment and it actually worked within 4 months I was able to pay off all of the debt I had all the credit cards all the loans I was finally able to get rid of all that stuff which was a huge burden off my shoulders and now the business was in profit mode so this was an eye opener for me now one thing I really wanted to do during this time for myself was I just had probably the two hardest years of my life after I graduated University with the blog failing the marketing agency failing at the beginning and then finally getting it back up so I said to myself you know what I I need to take a vacation I need to you know just take a week off and just go and enjoy myself so I remember calling my friend over to my house one day and I said look let's just spin the globe and let's just go somewhere wherever it lands and I kid you not we spin this globe and I touch my finger and we touch Colombia and at the time I'm like oh I don't even know anything about this country like is it safe is it okay can we go so I ended up packing my bags and I ended up visiting Colombia now this was the most transformational trip of my entire life when I landed in Columbia all of a sudden it was like all my worries left me for a little bit I was able to just develop I was able to enjoy myself go out meet different people do different things and that's where I started to realize like it doesn't stop here it doesn't stop just building this marketing agency to get out of debt there can be greatness achieved I started to become addicted to winning I started to become addicted with the idea of freedom being able to live or anywhere around the world I looked at Colombia and I was like why can't I live here why can't I just come down here and I started thinking about this and I couldn't get this thought out of my head after the vacation I came back to Canada I was still in my brother's apartment at the time and I just kept thinking to myself there has to be something I can do there has to be a way I can achieve this Freedom it doesn't just end here so I worked and I worked and I worked and I said you know what I'm going to pack my bags and I'm going to go live in Colombia for three months that was my plan let's go live in Colombia for 3 months avoid the Canadian winter I didn't want to experience that again and then come back when the winter is done and then I can go in and look to finding my own place in Canada and go from there that was my plan really literally game plan I ended ended up buying my tickets and then boom in January 2020 I left Canada to Colombia for 3 months now that's what I thought it was going to happen but a whole different situation ended up happening so during this time before I left to Columbia for the 3 months the business was rolling I was finally making money things were rolling business was taking off the marketing agency was the best it had ever been so I land in Colombia first month great enjoyed myself was making money was learning Spanish was just having a great time with my life the second month the pandemic hits all of a sudden I can no longer go back to Canada I'm stuck I even remember getting the email from Air Canada about my flight back they said hey Mr Assad we regret to inform you that your flight back to Toronto has been cancelled indefinitely and we do not know when there will be a return flight to go back so I'm literally sitting in there by myself in Columbia in my room like okay what am I going to do this was the best thing that ever happened to me because during this time I said you know what I can double down on the business I can grow this business to an even higher level than I even thought possible and that's exactly what I did week after week for the next few months I just built my business I started bringing in more clients I started scaling things because I was now in a distraction free zone it was literally me locked away for months able to build my business and I took full advantage then June 2020 comes around and I remember speaking with my friend the same Mentor I had from years ago asking him like you know how this all happened and he said well look you put in the work man you made this happen I was making six figures life was good I mean it was still the pandemic and I was locked inside but I was achieving my dreams from a computer desk in Colombia like how crazy was that just from the from my own apartment and I remember talking to him I said I think I can do more and he said what are you thinking I said you know what what if I turn this marketing agency into a coaching business I think I can help more people I think I can scale this business faster I think I can really really grow everything and achieve everything I want to achieve even faster and better and get my own clients better results and he said well that's another risk man are you ready to dive into that and I said yes I am so literally in June 2020 I decided to drop my marketing agency I gave all my clients away to my other marketing agency friends who had their own businesses and I started this coaching business from scratch I started a LinkedIn coaching business teaching people how to get clients from LinkedIn I said you know what instead of just reserving my done for you services for the few people who can afford it instead what I'm going to do now is I'm going to open my doors and teach every business owner whether you're a coach a consultant a solar preneur I'm going to teach you how to get clients from LinkedIn organically I did this for almost four years with other businesses and now I'm going to teach you how to do it for yourself and that is literally how my business took off to where it is today so it's crazy to think about that from June 2020 when I started this LinkedIn coaching business all the way until now April 2024 and we're going to keep going my plan is to keep scaling this as big as we can the amount of results and success we've gotten I've literally helped people from having a zero business I have this one guy who was a speaking coach who was selling his services at $72 an hour and I told him no let's turn this into a package where you can sell it at $3,000 let's go we got him to $122,000 a month I've even helped people for making $0 a month just an idea in their head to building a $30,000 a month coaching business this has happened multiple times and the reason I'm saying this is not to brag or anything like that but to show you how the Journey of Entrepreneurship unfolds now it's crazy to think about that just a few years ago in 2018 I was on the phone crying to my dad about how I couldn't be an entrepreneur how I got evicted from my office how I was filled with debt how I literally felt hopeless to literally now in 2024 living the life of my dreams right helping people growing a seven figure business doing all of this while traveling the world now I have literally grown this to the number one link coaching program in the world I say that because we have the best client results you can see them right here just look at these client results these are people who just had ideas in their head and they came to me to help them turn their idea into a profitable business and you can see the results people are literally turning ideas into reality with the right guidance so I'm telling you you can do the same too now the reason I'm telling you this is to inspire you too whether you want to be a coach a consultant an agency owner whatever you desire this can be a reality for you too you you just need to put in the work and make it happen I hope my story is just living proof that anything is possible regardless of your situation of where you're starting from maybe you're just quitting your job looking to start your first business whatever that situation might be I'm telling you you can make it happen just get the right mentors get the right guidance make sure you execute believe in yourself and it will happen if it can happen for me it can happen for you too so that's my story that's gotten me to the point of where I'm at right now I still believe this is still my chapter one I still believe there's so much more to go in my story and I only plan on growing from here thank you for listening to my story and I will see you in the next video take care
